claim_boundary: Finite word statistics can open or disfavor a structural mechanism; they cannot prove infinite survival, eventual periodicity, or irrationality.
mechanism_falsifier: A greedy tail with complexity or short-lag structure beyond the matched-random extremes opens a low-complexity/automatic analysis lane. Absence disfavors that lane in the declared exhaustive family and selected cohort.

independent_complexity_confirmation.persistence_rule: candidate new-segment p12 below the minimum of the predeclared matched null cohort

independent_lag_confirmation.persistence_threshold: same sign, |z| >= 3.290527, and at least half the persistent-signal expectation

parameters.deep_metric: lexicographic p(16), p(12); smaller is more structured
parameters.screen_metric: lexicographic p(8), p(10); smaller is more structured

programme_target: Solve Erdős 257; rational targets are disposable probes.
